title: Standard pre-release audit, end to end
code_snippet:
User: "Audit our dependencies before the 2.4 release."
Repo: single go.mod, go 1.23, 14 direct / 61 indirect, govulncheck and go-licenses both installed, worktree clean.
expected_feedback: Standard depth. Run gates 1-9 and record each class outcome. Load references/govulncheck-patterns.md. Produce all nine S9 sections, with S9.3 naming the exact command, its -scan level, its exit code, and per finding the evidence tier plus CVSS source or 'not retrieved'. S9.7 emits commands for the user to run; the audit runs none of them. S9.8 is non-empty. Append the scorecard with N/A items removed from the denominator.
coverage_rules: as commands for the user to run
